background_setting: A quiet outdoor parking lot on a clear day, featuring a compact circular roundabout with a landscaped central planter of shrubs. Grey asphalt surrounds the island, marked with faded lane lines and a directional arrow. Rows of empty parking bays and low kerbs line the perimeter, with a single clear exit lane opening to the right that leads onto the lot's exit road bordered by sparse greenery and light poles. No other vehicles or pedestrians are present.

aesthetics.patterns: Repeating parking-bay lines and evenly spaced light poles

context: Autonomous driving / dashcam demonstration of navigating a parking-lot roundabout and exiting onto a road

actions.description: The ego vehicle circles the landscaped roundabout, curving left around the central shrub planter under clear daylight with no other traffic. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle steers out of the roundabout through the right exit and continues along the exit road at normal cruising speed without slowing or stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the driver's POV shows the car already circling the small parking-lot roundabout, with the round shrub planter centered ahead and crisp shadows on the sunny asphalt. Through 0:01 and 0:02 the vehicle curves smoothly left, the green island sliding across the frame and the empty parking bays passing by. By 0:03 the clear exit lane opens on the right and the car begins steering out of the roundabout. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle straightens onto the exit road and continues at its normal cruising speed without slowing or stopping, the road and sparse greenery flowing steadily toward the camera as it heads for the lot's exit. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
